name: Welcome the Dead
oracle_text:
Draw two cards, then discard a card and you lose 2 life. Create X tapped 2/2 black Zombie Druid creature tokens, where X is the number of cards that were put into your graveyard from your hand or library this turn.
Flashback {5}{B} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
blocked_sentences: Create X tapped 2/2 black Zombie Druid creature tokens, where X is the number of cards that were put into your graveyard from your hand or library this turn.

needs.what: a value counting the cards put into a given player's graveyard this turn, restricted to cards that came from named zones (here: your graveyard, from your hand or library), e.g. {"cards_to_graveyard_this_turn": {"player": "you", "from_zones": ["hand", "library"]}}, read off a per-player, per-origin-zone tally in the TurnLedger
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cards_to_graveyard_this_turn returns ledger.cards_to_graveyard, one turn-wide integer over every graveyard at the table and from every zone (battlefield deaths included), and takes no player or zone spec; cards_discarded_this_turn misses milled cards and self-mill from library; count over your graveyard counts what was already there

needs.what: a 2/2 black Zombie Druid creature token
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has zombie_2_2_b (a 2/2 black Zombie, no Druid subtype) and other Zombie variants, but no Zombie Druid
